scripts.mobile:build:ios:release: cd apps/mobile && npx expo export --platform ios --output-dir /tmp/buzzfeed-ios-release && xcodebuild -workspace ios/BuzzFeedTravel.xcworkspace -scheme BuzzFeedTravel -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' archive -archivePath /tmp/BuzzFeedTravel.xcarchive CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY='' SKIP_BUNDLING=1 COMPILER_INDEX_STORE_ENABLE=NO && mkdir -p /tmp/BuzzFeedTravel-IPA/Payload && cp -r /tmp/BuzzFeedTravel.xcarchive/Products/Applications/BuzzFeedTravel.app /tmp/BuzzFeedTravel-IPA/Payload/ && cd /tmp/BuzzFeedTravel-IPA && zip -r $(git -C $OLDPWD rev-parse --show-toplevel)/builds/BuzzFeedTravel.ipa Payload/
